author: Gianmaria Canossa
name: GKit test project
description: xunit test project following the GKit.Tests conventions: a shared SQLite fixture rather than the EF in-memory provider, and bUnit when the project under test renders components.

target.description: Relative path of the project under test, e.g. ../Acme.Erp/Acme.Erp.csproj.

bunit.description: Include bUnit for component render tests.

sqlite.description: Include the SqliteFixture. Real SQLite matters: query filters and relational translation are what the interceptors under test rely on.
